action_summary: Round 23 measured the compounding half (cold 59 vs armed 35 questions on a never-seen period-12) but left the loop open at the program layer: the wake pass handled single-expression concepts only and silently skipped statement-function abstractions -- the ONLY entries the library admits by compression. Admission without replay is an append-only log. This round adds the measured replay engine (shape-matched, behaviour-verified on a probe grid with the abstraction as prelude, strictly byte-reducing, fail-closed, checked-artifact-is-returned-artifact), dispatches to it from both early-exit paths of the library wake pass, and pins the exploration negatives: ramps do not compress (already minimal) and world-model organs do not lift (outside the lifter's scope), so the table family is the only compressive corpus the current writer emits. Prediction written before the confirmatory run: a never-seen period-12 organ synthesized through the COLD path with a fresh library is rewritten by the wake pass to call the admitted abstraction. MEASURED: 179 bytes cold -> 112 bytes replayed (37% smaller, 67 bytes computed), behaviour preserved on 500+ held-out inputs, cold organ itself 0 held-out failures -- the replay changed cost, not correctness.
